truth: CORE-01A-H establish canonical Song/version identity, scoped evidence, Activity, Resume, provenance, recovery, Song graph and explicit Technical/Creative Twin semantics.
CORE-01H hosted exact-head proof remains UNOBSERVED and is not converted to green or allowed to block unrelated dependency-ready construction.
CORE-01I is the only active product increment and implements the minimum fresh-consumer context isolation contract for REQ-SCOPE-143.
Generic ProductContext is code-owned and user-data-free; it is not persisted per profile and imported material cannot replace it.

Private Artist/Song evidence remains in the existing physically isolated profile database. Imported/synced context is a separate append-only EVIDENCE_ONLY ledger scoped only to the active Artist or one owned Song.
Imported payload is not inserted into EvidenceMemory and does not grant mutation/execution authority even if the payload text claims otherwise.
No onboarding UI, Artist World maturation, cloud sync, universal search, broad Artist Graph expansion, DAW/audio work or second context database is selected in this increment.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
